verdict.rationale: Aleph documents user-configured background agents: natural-language prompts train them, they monitor source data 24/7 to map new accounts, vendors and dimensions, and they send Slack/Teams alerts for approval. It also claims reporting automation, pull/push sync and 'autopilot' for routine reporting and close. That background autonomy is evidenced only for the mappings use case, with approval gating, and the reporting-automation claims are marketing-level. Missing for 10: a general user-defined automation or workflow builder, scheduling/trigger configuration for arbitrary tasks, autonomous agent runs beyond mappings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
